gloss: to force; to compel; to coerce

definitions.gloss: to force; to compel; to coerce
definitions.explanation: To make someone do something against their will, or to impose something unwanted on someone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{強|し}いてはいけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't force someone to do the impossible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{強|し}いる⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ。
examples.english: Companies that force employees to work overtime are problematic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長期間|ちょうきかん}→長期間：25696_choukikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって⟦{不便|ふべん}→不便：01501_fuben⟧な⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{強|し}いられた。
examples.english: The residents were forced to endure inconvenient living conditions for a long period.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{強|し}いる is an ichidan verb despite ending in ⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧. The passive form {強|し}いられる is extremely common and often more natural than the active form.
- A⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧B⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{強|し}いる (to force B on A)
- {強|し}いられる (to be forced/compelled — very common passive)
- ⟦{強|し}いて→強いて：06664_shiite⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧ (if forced to say; if I had to say — set phrase)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{犠牲|ぎせい}→犠牲：14743_gisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{強|し}いる (to demand sacrifice)
- ⟦{我慢|がまん}→我慢：00057_gaman⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{強|し}いる (to force someone to endure)
- ⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{強|し}いる (to impose a burden)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{強制|きょうせい}→強制：12500_kyousei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is a suru-verb meaning to compel or enforce, often used for rules or systems. {強|し}いる is used more for interpersonal situations or abstract impositions.
